data.body: RCA + fix pushed as Gerrit change 1365 (Change-Id I2df0d654b6d4b4f132fc783dad43253c7eb2f759, commit 0c83eb0a97). ROOT CAUSE: build_bedrock_provider (src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py) returned BedrockProvider(region_name=region) with no botocore Config — llm_retry_max_attempts and timeout_s had no read site on the Bedrock path, so the client ran on botocore stock defaults (inert-config defect). FIX: the builder now constructs the bedrock-runtime boto3 client itself with Config(retries={'max_attempts': max(1,N), 'mode': 'adaptive'}, read_timeout=timeout_s, connect_timeout=timeout_s) and passes it via bedrock_client=. Semantics documented at the set site: botocore max_attempts = total attempts incl. first = tenacity stop_after_attempt(N); timeout_s bounds read AND connect (parity with the single httpx.Timeout); llm_retry_max_wait_s deliberately unmapped (no botocore equivalent). TDD: behavioral spy-session tests written FIRST, observed RED against the old builder; AC3 mutation check performed — reverted builder to BedrockProvider(region_name=region), both new tests went RED, restored, all 33 tests in tests/unit/test_bedrock_provider.py GREEN. Docs updated: runbook posture section (infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md), eb6e alarm description (infra/terraform/monitoring_eb6e.tf), docs/llm-framework.md, docs/config.md. make lint + make typecheck clean. Awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
